cues.en: This video is about the cassette tape. From the mid eighties through to the early nineties throughout my teenage years into my early twenties,
cues.zh: 这个视频讲的是盒式磁带。从八十年代中期到九十年代初，贯穿我的青少年时期直到二十出头，

cues.en: this was the way that I used to listen to most of my music.
cues.zh: 这就是我过去听大部分音乐的方式。

cues.en: However recently, I've heard people that are a lot younger than me, people who probably couldn't even remember listening to a cassette tape talking about it. And when they do, it pretty much always goes like this.
cues.zh: 不过最近，我听到比我年轻很多的人——可能根本不记得听过盒式磁带的人——在谈论它。而他们一谈，基本上总是这样。

cues.en: Yeah, of course. I remember tape. Do you remember you used to get the tape and you'd pull it out of the machine, all the tape would be stuck inside and then you'd have to wind it back in with a big and then you'd put it back in the machine. Yeah.
cues.zh: 是啊，当然。我记得磁带。你记不记得，以前你拿到磁带，把它从机器里拽出来，结果带子全卡在里面，然后你得用个大东西把它卷回去，再放回机器里。对。

cues.en: Tapes.
cues.zh: 磁带。

cues.en: Those things were terrible, weren't they? No, they're not. In fact they can be pretty good. Now this business about them getting stuck inside machines.
cues.zh: 那些东西很糟糕，对吧？不，它们并不糟。其实它们可以相当不错。至于卡在机器里这回事。

cues.en: I've still got all 200 and odd cassettes I bought in the eighties and nineties. They've all survived this long without stuck in any piece of equipment I've ever owned. Now I'm not saying other people haven't had cassettes get stuck inside machines.
cues.zh: 我还留着八九十年代买的两百多盒磁带。它们全都活到今天，从没卡在我拥有过的任何设备里。不过我不是说别人没遇到过磁带卡在机器里。

cues.en: I think it was most common in a car stereo on a hot day a sticky pinch roller that hadn't been cleaned for ages could pull a tape inside a machine.
cues.zh: 我觉得最常见的是汽车音响，大热天里一个很久没清洁的发粘压带轮会把磁带卷进机器。

cues.en: But it's not something that I've experienced. Now this business about them sounding bad.
cues.zh: 但这不是我经历过的事。再说说它们音质差这回事。

cues.en: Cassettes can actually sound remarkably
cues.zh: 磁带其实可以听起来非常

cues.en: good. How good? Well, that's what I'm going to try and find out in this video. I'm going to get some new equipment, try different noise reduction techniques, types of tapes,
cues.zh: 不错。有多好？这就是我在这期视频里要探寻的。我会入手一些新设备，尝试不同的降噪技术、磁带类型，

cues.en: and see if you can really get a tape sounding almost as good as a CD.
cues.zh: 看看你是不是真的能让磁带听起来几乎和 CD 一样好。

cues.en: So let's get on with the rest of the video. First off let's make no bones about it. The reason that most people bought cassettes
cues.zh: 那我们继续看视频的其余部分。首先，咱们有一说一。大多数人买磁带

cues.en: as opposed to CDs is because they were a heck of a lot cheaper. Almost half the price in most places and I know that's the reason that I bought mine. But however cheap something is, won't go back and buy it again unless they're happy with it and obviously they were happy with cassettes because it was the best selling format for the best part of ten years. However, because most of the people buying cassettes were on a restricted budget,
cues.zh: 而不是 CD 的原因，是因为磁带便宜得多。在大多数地方几乎是半价，我知道我买磁带就是这个原因。但不管一件东西有多便宜，除非买家满意，否则他们不会回头再买，显然大家对磁带是满意的，因为它在差不多十年的时间里都是最畅销的格式。不过，由于大多数买磁带的人预算有限，

cues.en: they were also listening to them on budget equipment and therefore never hearing the best that you could get out of a cassette.
cues.zh: 他们也是用廉价设备来听的，因此从来没听到过磁带的最佳音质。

cues.en: Now if they were recording anything they're probably recording off the radio and if they were doing it more than likely they weren't using decent quality tapes. Let's just have a look at the Boots catalog and see how much tapes cost back in 1985.
cues.zh: 而且如果他们录制什么东西，可能也就是从收音机里录的，如果真这么做了，多半也没用什么好质量的磁带。我们来看一下 Boots 百货的商品目录，看看 1985 年的时候磁带要多少钱。

cues.en: Well you can see why someone had used the cheap stuff. If you look at the boots pack of ferric sixty minutes, a three pack for $1.99
cues.zh: 你看得出为什么有人会买便宜货了。如果你看看 Boots 的氧化铁六十分钟三卷装只要 1.99 美元，

cues.en: or
cues.zh: 或者

cues.en: TDK d nineties for $3.49 for a three pack.
cues.zh: TDK D 系列九十分钟三卷装要 3.49 美元。

cues.en: Compare that to the top of the range metal tape here, the TDK metal m a r 90, $5.99
cues.zh: 再对比一下这里最高端的金属磁带，TDK metal m a r 90，售价 5.99 美元

cues.en: for a single tape. Let's put that in the inflation calculator and see what that's worth nowadays.
cues.zh: 单盘磁带。我们把它放进通胀计算器里，看看现在相当于多少钱。

cues.en: for a single tape. You can see why not many people were using those back in the day. But that segues us neatly into talking about tape types. Let's have a look at the four different kinds of blank cassette you could buy starting with the cheapest and worst on the left working up to the best on the right. So we've got a ferro,
cues.zh: 单盘磁带。你可以理解为什么当年没多少人用这东西了。不过这也自然过渡到了我们今天要聊的磁带类型。我们来看看你可以买到的四种不同空白磁带，从左边最便宜、最差的开始，一直到右边最好的。所以我们有铁基带，

cues.en: a chrome,
cues.zh: 铬基带，

cues.en: a ferrochrome and a metal. Convenient enough those are labeled types one, two, three and four. Now you won't see many type three tapes around. This was a bit of a failed experiment ferrochromium.
cues.zh: 铁铬基带和金属带。很巧的是，它们分别被称为一型、二型、三型和四型。现在你很难见到三型磁带了。这有点像是一次失败的实验——铁铬磁带。

cues.en: Type one's ferro and type two's chrome so you mix those together and you get ferrochromium.
cues.zh: 一型是铁基，二型是铬基，所以把它们混在一起就成了铁铬。

cues.en: The idea was it was the best of both of those two.
cues.zh: 当时的构想是集这两种磁带的优点于一身。

cues.en: That one had good bass response that had good treble response so add those two together you get ferrochromium.
cues.zh: 其中一种低音响应好，另一种高音响应好，把它们加在一起就成了铁铬。

cues.en: Bit of a failed experiment never took off you won't see those for sale at all nowadays it was only a couple years that those were on sale. So let's take that one out of the equation. So you've really got three different kinds of blank cassette you can find.
cues.zh: 算是一次失败的实验，从来没流行起来，现在你根本买不到了，当年只卖了短短几年。所以我们把它排除在外。实际上你现在能找到的空白磁带就只有三种。

cues.en: Type one, type two, and type four. Now it's easiest to go off the numbers because the manufacturers like to play around a little bit with the names of these. You'll notice these say normal position on them but also low noise and dynamic as well. So you can get a little bit confused with them. So just stick to the numbers type two chrome also known as
cues.zh: 一型、二型和四型。看数字最不容易搞混，因为厂商挺喜欢在这些磁带的名字上玩点花样。你会发现上面写着“普通位置”，但也写着“低噪”和“动态”。所以你可能会有点晕。所以记住数字就行，二型铬基带也称为

cues.en: high position.
cues.zh: 高位。

cues.en: And if we look at type four,
cues.zh: 再看第四类，

cues.en: well that just says metal class.
cues.zh: 上面只标了金属带。

cues.en: So just stick to the numbers. Type fours are pretty expensive but we'll talk more about that later on. Now I'm keeping this thing very basic. There'll be people out there that'll argue with me and say you can get better type ones and you can get type two sometimes if you get a good make etcetera etcetera. Yes there are always exceptions. I'm just keeping things very simple here. So if we put these on their ends you'll notice something about the tops of them. They've got different holes in them. We'll get that one out of the way because it's a bit see through, bit hard to see. We'll pull this other type one tape in. So we've type one on the front, type four on the back.
cues.zh: 所以先记住编号就行。第四类带相当贵，这个我们后面再细说。现在我讲的都是最基础的内容。肯定有人会跟我争论，说你能找到更好的第一类带，有时候也能买到不错的第二类带，只要挑到好牌子之类的，等等等等。没错，总有例外。我这里只是把问题尽量简化。那么把这几盘带子首尾相接摆好，你会注意到它们顶部的区别。上面的孔不一样。这盘先挪开，因为它有点透光，看不太清。再把另一盘第一类带拿过来。这样前面是第一类，后面是第四类。

cues.en: Notice you've got the little things that you pick out if you want to right protect them. But also next to those on the type two you've a hole and on the type four you've a hole next to those and two holes in the middle. Some cassette decks use these holes to identify what kind of cassette you've put in them because they need to know because you need to provide a metal tape with more power than you do a ferro tape to record onto it. Now some machines won't have those sensors but you'll find a switch on them and of course you've got to switch it to the right one so that it gives enough boost to the sound so it records it onto the tape. As I say metal requires a greater stronger signal to record onto than a ferro tape or than a chrome tape. Now as far as pre recorded albums go they generally either put them out on type one or type two tape ferro or chrome. One of these is one and one's the other. Let's see if we can figure it out. Looking at the side of the box there's no immediate indicators other than the Dolby symbol there. So we'll get the cassette out of the box and see if we can figure out if this one is on chrome
cues.zh: 注意上面那些小孔，想防止误抹就可以把它们抠掉。但除了这些，第二类带旁边有一个孔，第四类带在旁边有一个孔，中间还有两个孔。有些卡座就是靠这些孔来识别你放进去的是哪种磁带，因为它们必须知道，因为录制金属带需要的功率比铁带大。有些机器没有这些传感器，但上面会有一个开关，你当然得把它拨到正确的位置，好给足信号强度，把声音录到磁带上。就像我说的，金属带录音需要的信号比铁带或铬带更强。至于事先录好的专辑，通常要么用第一类带，要么用第二类带，也就是铁带或铬带。这两盘正好一盘一种。咱们来看看能不能分辨出来。看盒子侧面，除了那个 Dolby 标志，没有别的直接提示。那把磁带从盒子里拿出来，看看这盘是不是铬带

cues.en: or on type one. Well nothing on the cassette itself
cues.zh: 还是第一类带。磁带本身什么都没有，

cues.en: just the Dolby symbol again. So let's have a look at this other one and there you go. There's the symbol chrome. Now they don't always put this on but that one tells us this one should be on a chrome tape and of course we got the Dolby symbol as well. Now just imagine you found these cassettes without their boxes. There's no symbol on the cassette themselves to tell you whether or not it's type one or type two tape. You'd think well look at the top of the tape, it doesn't work. They're both in type one type cases. You see you only really need those notches when it comes to recording
cues.zh: 还是只有 Dolby 标志。那再看看另一盘，你看，这儿有 chrome 标志。他们不总会印这个，但这盘告诉我们它应该是铬带，当然也带了 Dolby 标志。现在想象一下，你找到这些磁带却没有盒子。磁带本身没有任何标志告诉你它是第一类还是第二类。你可能会想，看看磁带顶部不就行了，但这招不管用。两盘用的都是第一类带的壳体。你看，只有在录音的时候才真正需要那些缺口。

cues.en: on the tape. When you get to playback it doesn't make too much difference. You can always flip the switch if you want but it won't make a massive load of difference between type one and type two. You can tell which is which though if you wind them on.
cues.zh: 录在磁带上。播放时其实没太大区别。你想的话随时可以拨动开关，不过 I 型和 II 型磁带之间其实并没有那么大差别。但如果你把磁带快进一下，还是能分辨出哪个是哪个的。

cues.en: If you just wind it into the bit of tape past the header,
cues.zh: 如果你把磁带卷过头部那段空白，

cues.en: you'll see straight away there's a difference in color between the two tapes. So you can see the tape at the bottom is recorded on ferro tape type one and the type two chrome tape is the darker tape at the top.
cues.zh: 你马上就能看出这两种磁带颜色上的差异。所以你可以看到底部的磁带是用 I 型铁氧化物磁带录制的，而顶部的 II 型铬磁带颜色更深。

cues.en: Now let's move away from tape types and talk about that Dolby symbol. The back to back double D that you'll see on the boxes and on the cassettes themselves. Of course it's noise reduction. Now there are other kinds of noise reductions that were implemented
cues.zh: 现在我们抛开磁带类型，来谈谈那个杜比标志。你会看到包装盒和磁带本身上面都有背靠背的双 D 标志。这当然就是降噪功能。其实当时还实现过其他种类的降噪技术，

cues.en: such as DBX
cues.zh: 比如 DBX，

cues.en: but by far the most popular of these was Dolby so we're going to talk about that. Dolby noise reduction was first invented in the mid sixties and was for professional recording studios only.
cues.zh: 但其中最受欢迎的无疑是杜比，所以我们要讲的就是它。杜比降噪是在 20 世纪 60 年代中期首次发明的，最初仅用于专业录音室。

cues.en: However in 1968
cues.zh: 然而在 1968 年，

cues.en: a home version appeared which was called Dolby B
cues.zh: 推出了家用版本，名为杜比 B，

cues.en: followed quite a few years later by Dolby C and then finally by Dolby S which was right at the end of the home cassette boom
cues.zh: 几年后又相继推出了杜比 C，最后是杜比 S——它恰好出现在家用磁带热潮的尾声，

cues.en: on the high end machines only. Each version of Dolby was better than the one that came previously.
cues.zh: 并且仅限高端机型。每一版的杜比都比前一版更好。

cues.en: So what does Dolby do and how does it work? Well, I'll try to give the briefest possible explanation I can but if you really want to know about it properly then look at the Wikipedia article.
cues.zh: 那么杜比是做什么的？它是如何工作的？好吧，我会尽量给出最简短的解释，但如果你真的想彻底搞懂，请去查看维基百科的词条。

cues.en: The idea is you want to reduce the hiss or remove it if possible that's on a tape. Now you can do that by buying a metal tape as opposed to a ferric because that has a lot less hiss on it. But the idea with Dolby is it will reduce hiss irrespective of what type of tape you've bought.
cues.zh: 这个想法是你想减少或者尽可能消除磁带上的嘶嘶声。现在你可以通过买金属磁带而不是铁氧化物磁带副本来做到这一点，因为金属磁带的嘶嘶声要少得多。但杜比的想法是，不管你买的是哪种磁带，它都能减少嘶嘶声。

cues.en: Now, the way you get rid of hiss, if you were just to strip it off, you'd lose some of the sound with it because there are high frequency,
cues.zh: 现在，消除嘶嘶声的方法是，如果你只是把它剥离掉，你也会同时失去一部分声音，因为其中包含高频、

cues.en: low volume sounds that would get removed along with the hiss if you just to filter that part of the sound out. So what Dolby does, you record with it switched on,
cues.zh: 低音量的声音，如果你只是把那部分声音过滤掉，它们会连同嘶嘶声一起被移除。所以杜比的做法是，你在录音时开启它，

cues.en: it boosts up
cues.zh: 它会增强

cues.en: those parts of the sound that would have got lost, the high frequency low volume sounds, it boosts those and then when you play it back, you also have Dolby switched on and it brings them back down to where they should be, but also strips off the hiss off the bottom. At least that's the idea.
cues.zh: 那些本来会丢失的声音部分，也就是高频低音量的声音，它会增强这些声音，然后在你回放时，你也开启杜比，它会把它们降回到应有的水平，同时也剥离掉底部的嘶嘶声。至少理论上是这样的。

cues.en: Now of course, there's three different types of Dolby, b c and s that you might have. You've got to use the same version to play it back as you did to record it. If you don't, things will sound wrong. If you were to play back a Dolby recording that was done in say Dolby B without pressing the Dolby B,
cues.zh: 当然，现在有三种不同类型的杜比，你可能会遇到 B、C 和 S 型。你回放时必须使用与录音时相同的版本。如果不这样做，声音听起来就会不对劲。如果你回放一个用比如杜比 B 录制的录音，却没有按下杜比 B 按钮，

cues.en: it would sound too tinny,
cues.zh: 声音就会听起来太单薄、

cues.en: too bright.
cues.zh: 太刺耳。

cues.en: Equally,
cues.zh: 同样地，

cues.en: if you weren't recording Dolby but then you press the Dolby button on playback, things would sound too muffled.
cues.zh: 如果你录音时没用杜比，但在回放时按下了杜比按钮，声音听起来就会太闷。

cues.en: And of course, you're recording Dolby s playback using Dolby s etcetera.
cues.zh: 当然，你在用杜比系统录制杜比回放，等等。

cues.en: Now if you've got a pre recorded album and it's just got a Dolby logo on it, that'll be Dolby b. They always tend to be Dolby b. Occasionally you'll see things that say Dolby b HX Pro. Don't worry about the HX Pro. There's nothing that you have to do about that. It just means headroom extension.
cues.zh: 现在，如果你有一张预录好的专辑，上面只标了杜比标志，那就是杜比B。它们通常都是杜比B。偶尔你会看到标着杜比B HX Pro的。别担心HX Pro，你不需要对它做任何事。它只是意味着动态余量扩展。

cues.en: It was a bang and Olufsen technology that Dolby licensed, which just makes recording sound better. There's nothing that you have to do on the playback end. Now if you're looking to buy a machine and you want to know what kind of Dolby noise reduction it can handle, it'll usually have it written on the front. If it doesn't, have a look for the switch where you can select it and if the switch only shows Dolby noise reduction on and off, that means it's Dolby B. It's just when that machine came out they didn't know there was going to be a Dolby C and a Dolby S so they just thought it was called Dolby noise reduction.
cues.zh: 这是Bang & Olufsen的技术，杜比获得了授权，它只是让录音听起来更好。在回放端你不需要做任何事。现在如果你想买一台机器，想知道它能处理哪种杜比降噪，通常前面会写着。如果没有，找找选择它的开关，如果开关只显示杜比降噪开和关，那意味着它是杜比B。只是那台机器出来的时候，他们不知道后来会有杜比C和杜比S，所以他们以为这就叫杜比降噪。

cues.en: Now I'll quickly show you my main machine.
cues.zh: 现在快速给你看看我的主力机器。

cues.en: It's an absolute monster. It's the Pioneer's CTF twelve fifty but I'll be completely honest the main reason that I bought this specific machine is because I think it looks absolutely amazing.
cues.zh: 它绝对是个巨无霸。是先锋的CT-F1250，但老实说，我买这台特定机器的主要原因是我觉得它看起来太棒了。

cues.en: I think it's probably in need of a service to bring it up to its full strength, but it still sounds pretty damn good.
cues.zh: 我觉得它可能需要保养一下才能发挥全部实力，但听起来还是相当不错。

cues.en: Back in his day, it was a pretty expensive machine. In fact, it's still a pretty expensive machine, but it isn't exactly fully featured. It's only got standard Dolby noise reduction. Doesn't do Dolby C or anything because it hadn't come out then. However, it does have three heads. Why are three heads better than one? Well, looking at this reel to reel is easy to explain. Notice we've got erase on the left, record in the middle, and playback on the right. The idea is with three heads as well as separating them out which is supposed to be better, you can listen to what you've just recorded because the tape goes across the record head and then across the play head. So you can monitor live how the recordings are sounding and adjust things appropriately.
cues.zh: 在当年，这是一台相当贵的机器。事实上，它现在依然是一台相当贵的机器，只不过功能并不是特别全。它只有标准的杜比降噪。没有杜比C或者别的什么，因为那时候还没出呢。不过，它确实有三个磁头。为什么三个磁头比一个好呢？其实，看一看这个盘式录音机就很好解释。注意，左边是消音磁头，中间是录音磁头，右边是播放磁头。这个设计的好处是，除了将它们分开据说效果更好之外，你还能听到刚刚录下的声音，因为磁带先经过录音磁头，然后才经过播放磁头。所以你可以实时监听录音的效果并做出相应的调整。

cues.en: Now before the comments blow up with very opinionated people telling me what I should do such as buy an Akamichi Dragon. I'm not gonna go down that route. I want to try something very specific. I've never heard a Dolby s recording
cues.zh: 好了，在评论区被那些观点强烈的人刷爆、告诉我应该去买一台 Nakamichi Dragon 之前，我可不打算走那条路。我只想尝试一些非常具体的东西。我从来没听过杜比S录音

cues.en: and that's something I want to change. Looking at the adverts and things from the early nineties ninety two here, they were making some very bold claims for Dolby s. They were saying that it made things almost CD quality. Well that's something that I really want to try out for myself. So I looked on eBay to see if I could find a deck with Dolby s on it. Unfortunately
cues.zh: 而这正是我想要改变的。看看九十年代初——这里是92年——的广告和其他资料，他们当时对杜比S的宣传可以说是非常大胆。他们说这几乎能达到CD的音质。这真的是我很想亲自体验一下的。于是我在 eBay 上找找看能不能找到一台带杜比S的卡座。不幸的是

cues.en: they're very expensive. See Dolby s came right to the end of the heyday of the cassette recorder. It was only put on high end machines at the time and those still command a big premium. So I had to think a little bit outside of the box and I managed to find eventually
cues.zh: 它们非常贵。你看，杜比S诞生在磁带录音机黄金时代的末期。它当时只用在高端机器上，而这些机器现在依然价格不菲。所以我不得不跳出常规思考，最终我设法找到了

cues.en: this.
cues.zh: 这个。

cues.en: It's the Sony TCS
cues.zh: 这是 Sony TCS

cues.en: one. It's a MIDI deck which was part of a HiFi system.
cues.zh: one。它是一台 MIDI 卡座，属于一套 HiFi 系统。

cues.en: You could buy it separately and it'll work on its own and you can pick these up for, oh, as you can see here 60 odd quid. Apparently back in the day this was a really high end setup for a MIDI system anyway and it won quite a few awards in 1995 including one in what HiFi and a couple here as well. So I picked up one of these decks of course, as you can see it's a really nice looking machine. Very importantly Dolby s. It's got a few nice features on it as well.
cues.zh: 它可以单独购买，也能独立使用；你看，这里 60 多英镑就能淘到一台。据说当年这套 MIDI 系统配置相当高端，1995 年还拿了不少奖，包括一个 What HiFi 奖，这里也还有几个。所以我当然也收了一台这种卡座，你看，机器外观真不错。非常重要的是 Dolby S。它还有几个不错的功能。

cues.en: Especially noticed up here it's got an auto calibration
cues.zh: 特别注意到，这里有个自动校准

cues.en: feature. That's something I haven't had before. That should enable the deck to record on cassettes to the optimum quality. Now if we look around the back of the machine, you'll see it's a very simple setup. We've got a line in and a line out. That bus thing is to connect it to the other components in the range so you can control them all off a remote control and handily it's got an additional socket on the back which means I can plug other devices in my Hi Fi into this which means it won't take up an additional plug socket. Now whilst it might be a bit of a bargain compared to those full sized decks of course it isn't as fully specked. Whilst it does have Dolby c s h x pro track skip and auto reverse it is only a two head mechanism.
cues.zh: 功能。这是我以前没用过的。它应该能让卡座以最佳质量录制磁带。现在看看机器背面，你会看到接口很简单。有线路输入和线路输出。那个总线接口是用来连接同系列其他组件的，这样就能用一个遥控器控制它们；而且背面还多了一个插座，我可以把 HiFi 里的其他设备插到这台机器上，这样就不占额外插座了。虽然和那些全尺寸卡座比，它可能挺划算，但当然配置也没那么全。虽然它有 Dolby C、S、HX Pro、跳曲和自动反转，但机芯只是双磁头。

cues.en: There was one other thing I found on eBay and it was a pre recorded cassette that used Dolby s noise reduction. There was an intention to release pre recorded cassettes with Dolby s however this is just a promo off high fidelity magazine albeit it is on chrome tape so it shouldn't sound all that bad. So I gave it a quick go. Of course whenever you buy something off eBay you really do hope it works but you're too sure. However, this was working fine.
cues.zh: 我在 eBay 上还找到了另一件东西，是一盘使用了 Dolby S 降噪技术的预录制磁带。本来有计划发行带 Dolby S 的预录制磁带，不过这只是《High Fidelity》杂志的一个宣传样品，尽管它是铬带，所以听起来应该不会太差。于是我简单试了一下。当然，每次从 eBay 买东西，你都希望能正常使用，但心里又没太大把握。不过，这个运行得很正常。

cues.en: Now once you get it into the right Dolby version,
cues.zh: 现在，一旦调到正确的 Dolby 版本，

cues.en: it didn't sound bad at all.
cues.zh: 听起来一点也不差。

cues.en: However, one thing I did notice, I've got some scratches on the front of this which is a bit of a shame. It does spoil the look a little bit. However, I do have a solution for that and it's brasseau.
cues.zh: 不过，我确实注意到一件事，这东西正面有一些划痕，有点遗憾。确实有点影响外观。不过，我有一个解决方案，那就是 Brasso 铜油。

cues.en: Now most people will probably know this trick but if you don't, brasseau is a great way of getting rid of scratches
cues.zh: 可能大多数人都知道这个小技巧，但如果你不知道，Brasso 是消除塑料划痕的好方法，

cues.en: off plastic like on the front of this cassette recorder. You just have to rub it quite hard. It's abrasive so it takes the top off it a little bit, but as you can see there, the scratches are now hardly noticeable.
cues.zh: 比如这个盒式录音机的正面。你只需要用力擦拭。它具有研磨性，所以会磨掉表面薄薄的一层，但正如你在这里看到的，划痕现在几乎看不出来了。

cues.en: Now before I go and add it to the Hi Fi system, I think we better have a look inside it just to check everything checks out okay. So taking the lid off and it looks brand new in here. It was actually made as you can see there 08/23/1994
cues.zh: 在我把它加入 Hi-Fi 音响系统之前，我想我们最好检查一下内部，确保一切正常。打开盖子，里面看起来跟新的一样。正如你在那看到的，它实际上制造于 1994 年 8 月 23 日，

cues.en: so over twenty one years ago but looks pretty much as good as new. You can see the auto reverse mechanism working here spinning the head around and then playing the tape back in the other direction.
cues.zh: 所以是二十一年前的东西了，但看起来几乎和新的一样好。你可以看到这里的自动反转机制正在运作，磁头旋转，然后反方向播放磁带。

cues.en: And if we look at it we can see that it's very clean,
cues.zh: 如果仔细观察，就会发现它非常干净，

cues.en: very well put together, nicely spaced out components, obviously a high end piece of equipment back from the day.
cues.zh: 做工非常精良，各个组件布局合理、间距均匀，显然是当年一款高端设备。

cues.en: Anyway, put it back together and add it into the hi fi system so we can do a bit more testing with it. Now the first thing that I want to do is I can't really play you back any pre recorded music because
cues.zh: 总之，先把它重新组装起来，接入音响系统，这样我们就能继续做一些测试。首先，我想做的是播放一些预录制的音乐，但我没法这么做，因为

cues.en: we're going to fall foul of the usual YouTube copyright stuff. However, I really would like to show you how the different noise reduction techniques b c or s affect the sound.
cues.zh: 我们会碰上 YouTube 一贯的版权问题。不过，我真的很想让大家听听不同的降噪技术，也就是 B、C 或 S 降噪模式，对声音会产生什么影响。

cues.en: So I'm going to do that but with a blank cassette. Now I picked this one up that I found lying around type one. Notice it says four CD. They always used to do things like this towards the end of the cassette era trying to advertise cassettes that were for recording CD. It isn't. It's just a normal everyday type one cassette. Now I'm going to play this tape at full volume, but there'll be nothing on it, but you'll still hear the hiss that's on the tape on its own. And then we're going to try the different noise reduction techniques to see how those affect it. So get ready for a loud noise.
cues.zh: 所以我打算用一盘空白磁带来演示。我找到了这盘闲置的磁带，属于 Type I 类型。注意上面写着适用于 CD。磁带时代接近尾声时，厂商总喜欢搞这种宣传，试图推销所谓专门用于录制 CD 的磁带。其实并不是，它只是一盘普通的 Type I 磁带。现在我要把音量开到最大来播放这盘磁带，虽然里面什么都没录，但你仍然能听到磁带本身的嘶嘶声。然后我们会尝试不同的降噪技术，看看它们会带来什么变化。准备好迎接一阵巨响吧。

cues.en: Right. So that was quite impressive. You've got to remember though that this is done at a volume that I would never play anything at. It's far beyond what I could listen to. But let's try this again with a metal tape.
cues.zh: 好，刚才的效果相当惊人。不过要记住，这是在一个我绝对不会用来听音乐的音量下进行的，声音大到我根本无法忍受。接下来，我们用一盘金属磁带再试一次。

cues.en: If you could hear a bit of a there, that was just coming from my amplifier, not from the cassette deck. It's just because I've put it way up to top and there's a bit of a when you get past number nine. But I've never listened to this thing beyond about this position here so it's not something that you'd normally hear.
cues.zh: 如果你刚才听到了一点杂音，那是从我的功放机里传出来的，而不是卡式录音座。那是因为我把音量开到了最高，超过 9 这个位置之后就会出现一些杂音。但我平时听这玩意儿最多也就开到这个位置，所以正常情况下你是听不到这种声音的。

cues.en: Now because I'm never going to find any pre recorded metal tapes with a Dolby s noise reduction system on them. The only way I'm going to find out how good Dolby s actually is on a good quality tape is to record my own. So I've put a cassette into the machine and I've pressed the calibrate button. Now as far as I can tell, what this is doing is recording something onto the tape.
cues.zh: 既然我绝不可能找到带有杜比 S 降噪系统的预录金属磁带，那么想要了解杜比 S 在优质磁带上的实际效果，唯一的办法就是自己录制。所以我把磁带放进机器里，按下了校准按钮。据我所知，这个操作是在磁带上录制一些测试信号。

cues.en: Now it's going to listen back to it and that's going to enable it to calibrate itself so it records to its optimum quality on that particular cassette.
cues.zh: 现在它会回放这段声音，从而进行自我校准，以便在这盘特定的磁带上录制出最佳音质。

cues.en: Only takes a few seconds and once it's done, I can find some suitable high quality recordings to test out Dolby s. So I've got some nice clean acoustic high res tracks that I can record.
cues.zh: 只需要几秒钟，一旦完成，我就可以找一些合适的优质录音来测试杜比 S 了。所以我准备了一些干净、高解析度的原声音轨用来录制。

cues.en: Now if you hear any clicks, those are coming from my camera not from the source or from the cassette. It's just something that my camera is picking up for some reason. Now you want to drive metal tapes quite strong. So you want to go to the plus numbers a little bit. Get your record level just right before you start recording make sure it's just going up there into the plus four position
cues.zh: 如果你听到任何咔哒声，那是由我的摄像机发出的，而不是音源或磁带。这只是我的摄像机不知为何收录进去的声音。录制金属磁带时，输入电平要推得比较大。所以指针最好稍微进入正值区域。在开始录音前把录音电平调到正好，确保它刚好达到正 4 的位置

cues.en: and then take the pause off and start the recording.
cues.zh: 然后解除暂停，开始录音。

cues.en: So I spent about twenty minutes listening to the music whilst recording it at the same time and then I rewound the cassette. It's been so long since I recorded onto tape. I forgot how much fun you had while you were doing it. Anyway, listening back to the music,
cues.zh: 所以我花了大约二十分钟边听音乐边录制，然后把磁带倒了回去。我已经很久没用磁带录音了。我都忘了以前录音时觉得有多好玩。总之，回听这些音乐时，

cues.en: I really couldn't tell any difference initially. I was sat there and I was amazed at how good it sounded.
cues.zh: 我一开始真的听不出什么区别。我坐在那儿，惊叹于它的音质居然这么好。

cues.en: And I'm sure anyone would have been impressed if someone had come in and I'd have said, you're listening to a lossless recording.
cues.zh: 而且我敢说，如果有人走进来，而我对他说“你听的是无损录音”，任何人都会留下深刻印象。

cues.en: They'd have believed me. It sounded brilliant.
cues.zh: 他们会相信我的。听起来太棒了。

cues.en: But of course, a recording can't really sound as good as the original, especially on a tape. So I tried jumping back and forth between the source
cues.zh: 但当然，录音的音效其实无法和原声相比，尤其是录在磁带上。所以我试着在音源

cues.en: and the tape
cues.zh: 和磁带之间

cues.en: and sure enough, yes, there was a bit of a difference.
cues.zh: 反复切换，

cues.en: The original lossless file of course did sound better, but it was only when I compared them side by side that I could actually tell the difference. It just shows you how good you can get recordings
cues.zh: 果不其然，确实有一点区别。原版无损文件的音质当然更好，但只有当我把它们放在一起对比时，我才能真正听出区别。这正好说明了磁带录音

cues.en: on cassette. Now I embrace technology new and old and I wouldn't want to give away my digital music files and go back to having everything on analog tape.
cues.zh: 能达到多么高的水平。现在我对新老技术都持拥抱态度，我可不想放弃我的数字音乐文件，回到把所有东西都存在模拟磁带上的时代。

cues.en: However, that said, if technology
cues.zh: 话虽如此，如果技术

cues.en: hadn't advanced beyond the metal tape and Dolby s noise reduction,
cues.zh: 没有超越金属磁带和 Dolby S 降噪技术，

cues.en: I would be more than happy with the quality of the music that cassette tapes can produce.
cues.zh: 我对磁带所能产生的音乐质量也已经感到非常满意了。

cues.en: Now I know there's going to be so many people out there that are watching this and they're thinking what's the point in recording onto a cassette nowadays anyway? Well as far as I can make out there is no point.
cues.zh: 现在我知道肯定会有很多人看这个视频，心里会想：如今到底还有什么必要用磁带录音呢？嗯，依我之见，确实毫无必要。

cues.en: It's just something to do for a bit of fun.
cues.zh: 纯粹是图个乐子。

cues.en: Much like owning a model train set or going fishing, there's no real point behind it. You're just doing it because it's something you enjoy.
cues.zh: 就像收藏火车模型或者去钓鱼一样，背后没什么真正的目的。你做这件事，只是因为你喜欢。

cues.en: Not everything has to have a purpose. Now if you think you'd enjoy messing around with compact cassettes and you don't have a machine at the moment, if you look up in the video description you'll find I've got some links to the sections on eBay where I go looking for the different models I bought. Now you can go two ways with this. You can go vintage, get something from the sort of seventies and eighties which looks beautiful but might need quite a bit of work doing on it before it works properly
cues.zh: 不是所有事情都得有目的。现在，如果你觉得自己会喜欢摆弄紧凑型磁带，而手头暂时没有机器，可以看看视频简介，我在里面放了一些链接，指向eBay上我淘各种型号的板块。接下来你有两条路可选。你可以走复古路线，弄一台七八十年代的东西，看着很漂亮，但可能要花不少功夫打理才能正常工作

cues.en: or I'd recommend if you're starting out go to something from the very end of the format's life. Something in the nineteen nineties.
cues.zh: 或者我建议，如果你是刚入门，就选这个格式生命末期的东西。九十年代的。

cues.zh: 如果你在那里面找带Dolby S的机器，你也会知道那当年是顶级机型，其中一些正如我们所见，能以相当不错的价格淘到，当然如果它带Dolby S，那其他各种花哨功能也一应俱全。

Bye.
